reviews.text:
Do not bring your pet here if you care about them. This place has become a soulless factory that has grown too big to give any pet the individual care they need. All they care about is pumping your pet through to make money.

The disorganization is a headache to deal with, appointments are constantly lost when you arrive for them, there's no attention to detail given to your pets medical records and history, a doctor is never available when you need medicine approved, and they try to upcharge you every moment they can, even if your pet doesn't need it.

I've been coming here for years and have watched this play go down hill fast ever since their expansion to the new building. It's disheartening to see them just not care anymore and try to get your pet in and out as fast as possible. I'm not sure if it's under new management or what, but if you love your pet, go anywhere else.

DO NOT TAKE YOUR PETS TO THIS PLACE! They just added another building to this "business" and they are obviously wanting their patients to pay for it. They only care about their money and not your pet. We brought our dog Casper here because he was bleeding (from his bladder we think). They wanted to do x-ray's and do a urine test before treating him. They said we would get the results in 24-48 hours. They charged us approximately $800 and we were there for less than 10 minutes. We paid this because our little was hurting. They did not call us back. My wife started calling them where they proceeded to tell us it will take 5+ days before we get results which is complete BS. Of course the "doctor" was out if town and nothing they can do about it. We only care about our pet and if he had an infection why would we wait 5+ days to get medication? They tried to convince us that we did not hear what they told us. Then they said this was their policy. Does anybody really think it is reasonable to wait over 5 days for a simple urine test? Their office manage was rude to us on the phone when we called about this and when we talked to him on the phone he  continuously talked over top of me when I was trying to tell him what was said to us he was not listening to us at all. Did not seem to have any concern whatsoever about our dog who is family to us the only thing they care about is the money. We have five dogs and we've been bringing them here, even though they are more expensive than all of the other surrounding veterinarians. And that ends today. Did the rudeness of their office manager was the cherry on top? Talking over top of me and my wife both. We are not trying to get something for free. That's not the type of people we are. We make plenty of money. It has nothing to do with it money on our side. It has everything to do with the fact that they burned us and we feel like we're taking advantage of. They did not follow through with the care for our pet and they offered to give us $90 which is a slap in the face. We paid $800 for premium service and we did not get even subpar service. Thank God, our dog did not die! I highly recommend you choose another veterinarian because there are plenty around that truly love animals and this place is not one of them. I will probably be filing a small claim to get our money back because they refuse to do anything about it.
The doctor took a real interest in my pets and was able to get them updated with vaccines and a general exam.

Beware. This veterinary practice appears helpful, but your animal will leave with more problems than it arrives with and unnecessary medications. Look closely at the rug youll find fleas, too. I was recommended it and did not have a good experience with their sales pitch for my animals health.
Highly suggest seeking a practice that operates with care.

The McGrath veterinary center has been my dog's Doctor for many years; I have always found them to be efficient, knowledgeable and caring and could not recommend them highly enough.  I have also had the unfortunate need to use the new emergency hospital and felt the same.

My little girl Luna was spayed at McGrath veterinary center and Dr. Miller did such a wonderful job. She had absolutely no problem whatsoever no pain no discomfort. The incision healed in 10 days was absolutely wonderful in two weeks. I took her back and they are so loving and so wonderful at this that’s the Office. I so highly recommended the staff. Everyone is friendly wonderful the doctors are fabulous. I love every single that there and every single person that works there.
They are always punctual and all the staff are very friendly, they make you feel comfortable.

We are so grateful to Dr. McGrath and his team. We came to him for a second opinion on our senior dog, and he was incredibly thorough and thoughtful in his assessment. He took the time to explain everything in enough detail that we truly understood what was going on and felt confident about the path forward.

From start to finish, we felt genuinely cared for. Our appointment was on time, the staff was warm and efficient, and we never felt rushed. The experience gave us so much confidence in Dr. McGrath that we’ve decided to make his office our permanent veterinary practice. Highly recommend.

My cat 🐈 Lola was put to sleep here and everyone was very nice , considerate of our pain and guided us through everything to give Lola a nice and descent goodbye. Thank you everyone in this veterinary hospital ♥️

One of the most expensive places you could possibly bring your dog. There is zero thought going into the care of your animal. The veterinarian just orders every possible test for thousands and thousands of dollars for what might be possibly wrong rather than using their education to figure out what might be wrong and minimize the amount spent. I have heard from numerous people that this is the modus operandi for McGrath Veterinary Center. If you want to spend your entire year’s paycheck for a new limp in your otherwise healthy dog, feel free to visit this place
they take the best care of my Randi girl.  Can’t recommend Mcgrath enough

Mc grath Veterinary is outstanding ! The best pet clinic and hospital in the San Fernando valley .
Their Excellent team consistently provides quality care for both my dogs .
Caring staff , appointments are on time and the doctors provide detailed explanations for any treatment needed .
We are so happy with this practice ! I’ve taken my cats to both Dr McGrath and to Dr Miller and they were kind , thorough and patient . I highly recommend this place !
Truly the best! From staff to the vets, my pup and I have been shown a lot of care. I am so grateful.

I had such a positive experience at this clinic during an incredibly stressful time with my pets. I wanted to give a shout-out to Abby who listened with genuine compassion as I cried over the fear of my pets being hospitalized next door at McGrath's and even offered me tissues, which meant so much in that moment.

The next day, she remembered both of my pets' names and even advocated for me to be seen between two appointments because she knew how worried I was. That level of kindness and care is something I'll never forget. Thank you, Abby, and the entire team, for making me feel so supported.

Dr. McGrath gave my best friend her life back! Don’t go anywhere else.

I love my dog, Bailey, more than most people. She is my absolute best friend, and recently, I had to watch her go through agonizing pain while being completely failed by another animal hospital.
For context, I had been taking Bailey to ACCESS Specialty Animal Hospital in Woodland Hills. Last September, she was diagnosed there via MRI with mild spinal cord compression (a bulging disc) and a bad inner ear infection. They gave her gabapentin, prednisone, antibiotics, and pain relievers. She recovered and was doing great for about seven or eight months, but then a month ago, the nightmare started again. Bailey was yelping, crying, shaking, panting, and hiding under the bed and in the bathroom. She was in so much pain she wouldn't even let anyone touch her.
I took her back to ACCESS, and they just threw more prednisone, trazodone, and muscle relaxers at her. Two weeks passed with zero improvement. I couldn't just keep covering up her agony with medication. I took her back, and they kept her overnight for observation and fluids—which cost me almost $3,000 (on top of an $850 initial visit). When I brought her home, absolutely nothing had changed. She was still crying and suffering just as much. I called them back a week later begging for help because this wasn't okay, and they promised someone would call me back. They never did. I spent thousands and thousands of dollars, and they just left my dog to suffer.
In desperation, I brought Bailey to McGrath Veterinary Center in Sherman Oaks, and it was a night-and-day difference. From the second we walked in, the staff was incredibly careful, gentle, and showed that they genuinely cared.
Dr. McGrath came in and was completely straightforward. He didn’t beat around the bush or sugarcoat anything. He actually took the time to read the MRI I brought with me. Instead of just throwing more sedatives at her, he realized that based on her history, there must be an underlying infection causing this. He prescribed an antibiotic and a pain reliever.
I swear to you—within TWO DAYS of taking the antibiotics from Dr. McGrath, Bailey was completely back to her old self. Two days!
I am overwhelmingly thankful and happy to have my girl back, but I am also furious that she was left in agonizing pain for weeks because her previous vet couldn't be bothered to prescribe an antibiotic for an infection they knew she was prone to.
I cannot thank Dr. McGrath and his amazing team enough. If you have an animal that needs care, please don’t waste your time or money anywhere else. Even if you live far away, make the drive to Sherman Oaks. They will actually figure out what is wrong and take care of your best friend. I cannot say enough good things. I am forever grateful!
Best emergency services ever. Got us in right away. Poor Harry is allergic to bees
One of the only vets in the sfv equipped to handle genuine pet emergencies. Staff is knowledgeable, polite and caring. Not cheap but for our furry friends do not accept second best.
The kindest people. They took our cat late in the evening on the same day after someone else canceled. We are so thankful.
Always great service at McGrath, and you can usually get an appointment within 24 hours (often less) without a rush charge, because they have numerous vets on staff.

I’m not usually someone who leaves negative reviews because I truly believe every clinic can have on and off days. To be fair, I’ve had pleasant experiences with Dr. McGrath previously during routine visits for my other cat’s eye surgery follow-ups. However, after this recent experience, I do feel it’s important to share my concerns because I don’t believe my cat received the level of care and attention he needed during hospitalization.

My cat was hospitalized for 2 nights and 3 days for pancreatitis with a 104 fever upon admission. While I understand pancreatitis can be difficult to manage, my biggest concern was the lack of communication, follow-up, and overall attentiveness during his stay.

After the first night, no one from the hospital proactively contacted me with updates. I had to call multiple times myself, and each time, no one seemed to have a full understanding of his condition or treatment plan. I was repeatedly told Dr. McGrath was not there that day, so detailed updates could not be provided.

I eventually went to visit my cat in person because I was uncomfortable with the lack of information. When I arrived, I again received very little explanation. What concerned me further was seeing my cat sitting alone in a cage with only a litter box, food, and water — no blanket or bedding. I was told this was because they wanted to keep his temperature down due to the fever. However, it honestly felt more like staff were avoiding handling him because his chart had been marked “will bite.”

I’ve had several special-needs pets over the years requiring hospitalization for conditions like CKD, seizures, hydrocephalus, and cancer, so I understand stressed animals can be difficult. My cat is highly anxious in unfamiliar environments, which I explained beforehand. In past experiences at other hospitals, I’ve consistently seen staff make efforts to calm and comfort anxious pets. Unfortunately, that compassion felt lacking here.

The following day, Dr. McGrath called and said my cat could be discharged. However, after asking questions, I learned:

1. His fever had still not resolved.
2. He was still not eating on his own.

The only improvement was that he had stopped vomiting — which was not surprising considering he had barely eaten.

Despite this, we were not given any meaningful home care plan beyond being told to syringe feed him because “he needs to eat.” Unsurprisingly, the vomiting returned almost immediately after discharge.

Thankfully, I sought a second opinion from an internal medicine specialist shortly afterward. We were then provided antibiotics for the persistent fever (which improved quickly), subcutaneous fluids for hydration, anti-nausea medication, pain management, and an appetite stimulant because he had not eaten properly for nearly a week. According to the specialist, these were all important considerations given his condition.

I’m sure there may be medical explanations for why certain treatments were or were not pursued. However, from my perspective, after 3 days of hospitalization my cat showed little improvement and was discharged without a thorough aftercare plan or follow-up support. No one checked in afterward to see how he was doing despite his unresolved symptoms at discharge.

I know many people may have had positive experiences here, but unfortunately this was not mine. I’m grateful I trusted my instincts, advocated for my cat, and sought a second opinion when I did because thankfully he is now recovering well.

I’m sharing this review not out of anger, but because I think it’s important for other pet owners to have a full picture when making decisions about their pet’s care.

I'm giving 2 stars simply because of the kindness Savannah showed my cat during his stay.

--------

Update: I appreciate Dr. Mcgrath directly calling me to fully understand the situation and what my concerns and frustrations were. And again, I fully understand that there are many factors to how things were addressed during our visit. thank you for addressing them.

They were very nice, but I feel that their diagnosis of what was wrong with my cat came a week too late. My vet who was closed would’ve had it that day and I feel they are wvery nice, but I feel that their diagnosis of what was wrong with my cat came a week too late. . My Vet would’ve had it that day and I feel I was charged $300 more than my own Vet would have charged me again they are very nice but I will never go back there again. .

Update: after being a client here on and off for years - I had 3 previous dogs seen at this clinic. Now I have a new puppy who got an ear infection 5 weeks ago I have spent almost $1400 for an ear infection to which she has ZERO symptoms after the initial treatment,  but am told there’s still bacteria in her ear. I am on her 3rd treatment. Never ever have I had a dog not be able to clear an ear infection. Especially after oral and topical treatments. The prices attached to my initial email were $20-30 LESS per service than what I end up paying at the clinic. (Which adds up) So far just to recheck her ears and tell me I need to buy more over priced meds each visit is anywhere from $462, $256, $393 etc.INSANE!  I mentioned this and that the email prices sent were way less and felt I was gaslit and told that’s why we give you the estimate before- totally missing the point they have really upped their prices and you are in the lobby with your dog in the back. Not cool

I won’t be back.

The staff is one of the most compassionate and kind I’ve encountered. It’s probably easy to get jaded in this business but somehow this veterinary practice manages to keep and calm and empathetic environment. Can’t say enough good things about this practice !

I couldn’t be more grateful for the care my 14-year-old puggle received at McGrath Veterinary Center. After struggling with multiple health issues and feeling like our previous vet visits were always rushed and incomplete, this experience was a complete turnaround.

Dr. McGrath took the time to truly listen and approach my dog’s health holistically, performing a thorough evaluation and developing a thoughtful, effective treatment plan. The results have been remarkable—my puggle is now walking farther and is more active than she’s been in years.

It’s such a relief to finally feel confident that my pet is receiving the attentive, high-quality care she deserves.

Do NOT bring your pets here!!!! My dog got sick and my regular vet didn't have availability so I brought her here.
I paid just under $400 for everything they did. The appointment was with them yesterday 4/9 , this morning my dog was screaming in pain when I tried to pick her up, each and every time I tried, she'd scream when I touched her. I had to take out of work again to get her to our regular vet who was amazing enough to squeeze her in. Too many mistakes were made by them including sending me multiple people's invoices to my email before we even got to the appointment. Super big red flag! Please do not bring your pets here!!

I have been going to this vet for 5 1/2 years, ever since I rescued my sweet little girl. I recently had to put her down as her little heart gave out. My primary vet there was Dr. Miller and this was a very sad situation. Dr. Miller and the staff made this much easier. They were so caring and thoughtful and they gave me time with her. They were very helpful during this situation. Dr. Miller is fantastic. She is very knowledgeable and very warm, caring & friendly. The whole staff in this office is great. They are all friendly, helpful and kind. I always received a call the day after a visit to check on my girl.

No other vet has offered the white-glove service that McGrath vet has. They send reminders, check in after appointments and MOST IMPORTANTLY they treated my cat and myself very well: they listened, offered options for treatment (including offering a script for Chewy before I even had at ask!) and actually listened instead of dismissing our concerns. I'm so happy I found them. They prioritize the pet, and that's #1!!

I've been taking my dog, Bailey, to McGrath since 2022, about six or seven visits. My experience has been extremely positive. I would not hesitate to recommend them, and I have recommended them to my family and friends. The staff is friendly and welcoming. They always greet Bailey, which I find endearing and reflective of how they view all their customers, be they two or four legged.
I appreciate that they explain everything clearly. I never feel rushed during appointments, and they always answer all my questions thoroughly. It's clear they genuinely care about animals and their well-being.
When Bailey had kennel cough they were especially patient and supportive, and their treatment plan worked perfectly.
The clinic itself is always clean and well-maintained, and their reminders about appointments, via email, are helpful.
Overall, McGrath provides excellent care for my dog. I trust them completely and wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for a caring and skilled veterinarian.

This review is long overdue, but I wanted to make sure to give a shoutout to the amazing McGrath team. I have taken my mini-golden doodle to them for years before moving to San Diego and they have always provided top tier care. Scheduling is flexible, wait times are reasonable, staff is friendly, and parking nearby is always available. The staff has also gone above and beyond for us, specifically when I was in a bind to get mandatory vaccines prior to dropping my pup off for boarding that same day - calling them en route driving from SD to LA, they empathized with my situation and were able to fit in an appt around the exact time we were expected to arrive in LA (absolute life savers!!). I still benefit from the email reminders re: my doggo's upcoming vet needs (e.g. immunizations) and take her to them whenever we make an LA visit. Highly recommend!!

We have been going to McGrath for years for our dogs, especially whenever we have a more urgent or emergency need. We've had dogs hospitalized multiple times here and have always been impressed by the doctors and staff. They can always get us in ASAP when we have anything urgent and we do not have any wait time once we arrive. Most recently, our 7-month-old puppy was hospitalized here for 3 nights due to pneumonia over Christmas holiday. Despite being closed on Christmas Day, they were still able to hospitalize him and had a technician watching over him 24/7. Our pup was up and down in regards to his stability, and they continued to change their care plan in response to his symptoms/progression. We went to them initially with a pup who could barely walk and looked like he was on death's door. We left with a pup who was basically back to normal and happy to come home and open his Christmas gifts. Without MVC, I am not sure if our Ludo would have survived. This is the second dog of ours that they have saved (they also saved Lucy's life by performing a spleenectomy). Our team this go around was Dr. Dhillon and Dr. Miller. Both were so attentive, caring, and thorough.

We waited less than 5 minutes before we were takenintto the exam room.   Dr. Mc Grath was very gentle and caring with our dog, Harris. Although our dog was very nervous, the doctor got down one the floor and reassured her.  He said he needed to do blood work on her and a tech came in to take her to the back. of the facility.  She , also, was very kind and patient with Harris.

Drastically overcharged for the quality amd type of care given. was recommended this vet in a pinch to get my cat examined quickly. the prices were almost 2000.00 dollars more than any other vets I've gone to.

the urgent care in noho charges 1/3 the price for the same care given

I had an exceptional experience at McGrath Veterinary Center. The service here is truly outstanding by far the best I’ve ever received for my pets. The entire team is professional, attentive, and extremely caring. They don’t just treat animals; they genuinely care about their well-being.

My cats were seen by Dr. Elysa Braunstein so many many time and she is absolutely incredible. She explained everything thoroughly, answered all of my questions with patience, and provided clear guidance for treatment and follow-up care. What impressed me the most is how she treated my cats as if they were her own. Her kindness, expertise, and the way she handles animals with such compassion gave me so much confidence and peace of mind.

I can’t recommend this place enough. If you’re looking for a veterinary clinic that truly goes above and beyond—with exceptional knowledge, heartfelt care, and top-tier service—this is the place. McGrath Veterinary Center is genuinely the best.
Great vet techs and vets. The techs are great with our big Anatolian pup. Dr. Medina saved our sweet cocker girl who had heart worm. Reception is so sweet and helpful. Great practice!

We had such a wonderful experience at McGrath Veterinary Center. From the moment we walked in, every single person—from the front desk staff to the vet techs—was incredibly kind, patient, and caring.

Dr. Dhillon did an amazing job with my dog’s dental cleaning and extractions. He explained everything clearly, treated my dog with such gentle care, and truly put my mind at ease throughout the process.

I’m so grateful for the entire team and so glad I trusted McGrath with my dog’s care. They went above and beyond, and I couldn’t recommend them more!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I’m so thankful for the care my Happy receives here. Everyone was kind, patient, and genuinely attentive from start to finish. Dr. Brian is incredibly knowledgeable, and was so patient with me. He listened to all my concerns, explained everything clearly, and made sure my pet felt comfortable the whole time. You can tell he truly cares about what he does and about every animal that comes through the door. The staff were just as kind and professional, and I am touched with how personable and welcoming everyone has been. The place is spotless and well-run, and parking (metered as well as street parking! 😊) is super easy, which makes visits way less stressful. The prices are very reasonable, especially for how thorough and caring they are. I am so grateful for McGrath Veterinary Center and how much they have done for my dog.

This place has gone incredibly down hill. Have been coming here with two dogs for nearly a decade and they used to be excellent. Now, they take too many appointments, they can’t keep vets long term so you’re always seeing different people, and they’re pretty careless in what they do (billing mistakes, etc.). My latest experience was them seeing my dog for some allergies, checking her glands, and then somehow my dog is having blood in her stool immediately after gland expression.  They claim that it was stress induced from her having been there so long… Maybe they shouldn’t have kept her in the back for 45 minutes for a simple gland expression.

While this place was convenient and used to be great, I have to implore you to go elsewhere.
Very helpful, ans super caring 👍 …

We had an urgent situation for one of our dogs (Olde English Bulldogge) and unfortunately our own vet was not available.  They referred us to McGrath Vet Center.  To my great delight when we called I was able to make a appointment for the same day.  When we arrived we were taken such great care of and could not have been happier.  The staff and doctor were sweet, kind, gentle, patient and very kind and knowledgeable.  We are referring McGrath to all of our pet owner friends & family and so happy we found an Urgent Care MUCH CLOSER to our home!!!

This review is long overdue and the only reason I’m giving two stars versus one is because of Doctor millers kindness and compassion. I’ve had bad experience after bad experience with other vets here and I even tried to get in touch with management after a Indian doctor didn’t even examine my dog but I was still charged an examination fee, but the manger never bothered to call me after many attempts on my part. I came back in tonight because they’re one of the only places open and my puppy walks up to the doctor and she wants to muzzle him, taking him in the back to try and muzzle him only to fail and bring him back to me to say can you try? Why is the muzzle necessary when he’s calm and comfortable with this unknown doctor upon her walking in? He had a bad experience here prior with a nail technician, which was not in front of me but rather in the back. Doctor Miller is the only decent thing about this place and I’m not even getting into the time I was left to wait in a room around 7:45 am on a Saturday for 30+ mins while the front staff was too busy socializing and I had to remind them I was in the room.

I have a 9-year-old German Shepherd who was going to a local and well-reviewed vet. She sold her practice to an investment firm during the pandemic, and the quality of the care spiraled poorly. I was very disappointed, but I needed to find a new vet.

I posted on Facebook and asked all my friends about their vet. I got about a dozen recommendations, and I called each with some standard pricing comparisons. I figured McGrath wouldn't be a good option because it was recommended by one of my wealthier friends, who is very focused on caring for her fur babies. But I was pleasantly surprised to find that McGrath was the most affordable in my survey, could accommodate a first appointment quickly, and the staff on the phone was the most helpful.

I've now been for two appointments: an introduction and some blood work and to review a small cyst growing on his leg. We saw Dr. Miller for the first time, and she's now his vet. We've always been able to get appointments quickly and never had to wait more than 15 minutes. Dr. Miller is kind. She explains everything very well. She balances cost consciousness with proper medical treatment.

I did a lot of research before choosing McGrath, and I couldn't be happier with my decision.

UPDATED - September 2025: It's wild to look back at this review because I've continued with McGrath and had an incredible experience.  I now have a 2 year old shepherd.  We lost the older fella last year, but received excellent care.  The pup has taken to Dr. Medina so she is his primary vet. But at McGrath, it's nice to know that you can almost always get an appointment right away.

Let me start by saying, we are veterans of veterinarians (couldn't resist the pun), having had furry family members for more than 30 years.  We started going to McGrath a few years ago, first for our dog, and then for our cats.  They have been absolutely spectacular.  First of all, the quality of care is exceptional.  The exams are aways thorough, even if they have squeezed you in last minute. From the vets to the techs to the receptionists, everyone is really dedicated. I had an issue with my pet insurance, which required me to resubmit records repeatedly, and ultimately the vet and the manager each wrote letters vouching for my cat's medical needs.  Second, their hours are wonderful.  Third, their waiting room is large and clean and there are plenty of places to sit. Finally, parking is never a problem!  I can't say enough good things about our experience with McGrath--we feel so fortunate to have found them.

Hands down the worst veterinary experience I have ever had.

I called ahead and was quoted around $500 for a procedure. It seemed reasonable so I decided to bring in both of my dogs and establish service with this clinic.

HUGE mistake. Always get it in writing.

Instead of doing any of the additional work discussed on the phone, they ran up fees just to take my dogs in, then handed me an $1,100+ quote for the same procedure. That is more than double the original number, and they now deny the $500 quote was ever mentioned.

When I voiced my concern, they initially agreed to refund one of the fees. I made clear that was not how I would handle a client situation myself and that I would be leaving a review. Their “business manager” Serge then accused me of extortion for daring to say I would reflect the experience in a review. He then dangled a meager $95 refund. I accepted, but said it would still be reflected in my comments.

Instead of honoring even that, Serge and Dr. McGrath revoked the refund entirely, claiming again that standing by my word to leave a review was “extortion.” The irony is staggering. They took $190 in “consultation fees,” delivered zero value, and doubled the quote once I was in the door. And yet, they are the ones crying foul?

As a business owner, I welcome feedback and treat clients with respect. The fact that a veterinarian’s office, one that should be dedicated to compassion and care, chooses to gaslight, nickel and dime, and then shame paying customers is appalling.

Shame on Dr. McGrath and Serge. They have tarnished their own reputations and, worse, the reputation of their profession. There are countless veterinary offices that provide genuine care with honesty and integrity. This one is not among them, and sadly I have come to know this is a common experience through others post engagement.

Do yourself and your pets a favor: stay far, far away.

We live near McGrath Veterinary Center and have been doing there for five years with our dog. The Veterinarians are incredibly knowledgeable and friendly, and the other staff is always pleasant. We trust them implicitly.  Highly recommend.

I called last night just before closing with an emergency and Heaven at the front desk was amazing! She was very patient and understanding and was able to point me in the right direction for help. I’ll be bringing my cat here for future check-ups for now on.

I am VERY particular about the care of my animals and have had a variety of vets throughout the years. McGrath is consistently phenomenal.  The staff on the phone provide so much detailed information and always address my needs in a timely manner. When we had to put my baby to sleep they scheduled an emergency visit.  It was the day of the Microsoft crash and every other hospital wasn't taking patients because their systems were offline. They let me hold him as he left the world and even cut out heart bandages and put them all over where the IV injection site was. The follow up cards, calls and extra care are something I will remember for the rest of my life.  They showed so much care and in the most delicate way. I will bring all of my animals here.

We just recently moved and needed a vet for an emergency service. I called on a Sunday night at 6 PM and they had an appointment ready for us at 8:30 AM the next morning. Absolutely wonderful staff! They were so welcoming and so warm and loving towards our kitten.

Avoid this vet. Our 5yo cat unexpectedly started having seizures and ataxia, so we rushed her to McGrath. When the seizures happened, I tried to rule out anything that could be causing it, so I checked her food, and to my horror I realized that I had been mistakenly been feeding her Applaws supplemental salmon/tuna food, which is not a complete diet, and I realized that she was likely malnourished. I made this mistake as Applaws sells *both* complete and supplemental cat foods with very similar branding, and I did not realize the difference.

Upon looking into this, I found many studies that exhibit how malnourished cats can experience seizures, ataxia, and other neurological issues.

Upon coming in, my husband and I informed Dr. Marino of all of this and asked if she thought that the malnourishment could be what is causing our cat's seizures. Dr. Marino immediately dismissed this, she said it was "unlikely", and we felt that she was being condescending toward us by saying "I always say there's no stupid questions".

McGrath kept our cat overnight, ran bloodwork + PCR test, x-rays, stabilized her with anti-seizure medication, and prescribed her Keppra. We paid thousands for this. Afterward, Dr. Marino said they did not know what was causing the seizures and that we needed to take our cat to get an MRI (which can also cost thousands). We inquired again about the nutrient deficiency, and asked if we could test for this, and Dr. Marino said "No, and you'd be wasting your time".

So, we brought our cat to a different vet. They did comprehensive bloodwork and ran a fur analysis, and confirmed what we suspected: they determined that our cat was *extremely* deficient in Calcium, Cobalt, Manganese, and had extremely high Mercury levels (due to the Applaws tuna/salmon), all of which are known to contribute to neurological issues/seizures in cats. They also determined that she was low very in iron. They prescribed us supplements and a Mercury detox, got her on high quality food, and weaned her off of the Keppra.

This was 3 months ago, and our cat has made a full recovery, is completely healthy, and hasn't had a seizure or any issues since.

In addition to this, when we picked up our cat after her overnight stay, they gave us to her in her carrier with a stack of old, used pee pads, and she reeked like pee. We found this to be neglectful and completely unprofessional.

Highly recommend McGrath Veterinary Center.  Our "kiddies" have been going their for 8 years and the compassion and care of the entire staff is wonderful.  Hours of operation are excellent and the following up care from front office staff as well as the doctors is so appreciated.
Really half assed diagnostics by a vet who is impossible to reach. Almost mistakenly put my cat down.

Everyone here is phenomenal. They have taken world class care of our dogs and cat through good times and bad. The staff are both kind and expert. They give clear advice and communication as well as high empathy. Highly recommend.

Cannot recommend McGrath Vet Center enough! We had an emergency situation- rattle snake bit our dog- on a Sunday morning. Dr Medina was fantastic. They acted quick, kept us informed. Every time I have been to McGrath, they are always calm, understanding, and truly care for my dog. Never rushed, always listening to the issue, and really seem to enjoy what they do.
Everyone here was so nice, the doctor explained to me everything patently.  I definitely  recommend it.

Wouldn’t trust my doggos with anyone but Dr McGrath and his amazing staff. They have been there for us time and time again and my pets love them. Highly recommend.

the front desk staff are incredibly kind as well.

i’ve come here for 2 emergencies and vaccinations and have gotten consistent A+ service every time.

My little guy is alive today because of McGrath. After weeks of calling and visiting what felt like every vet in the Valley, I finally found this place. The staff was incredibly caring. Nice solid clinic

Our family adopted our beloved Jetty Wetty five years ago from the East Valley Animal Shelter. As part of the adoption process, the shelter automatically set us up with a "free" visit at a local vet clinic in Sherman Oaks. I thought, Great! A trusted vet clinic! However, that initial visit turned out to be far from "free." While the exam itself may have been covered, additional tests and blood work were recommended, and by the end of the visit, I was handed a bill for a few hundred dollars. Despite my surprise, I trusted the clinic and continued taking our dog there for several years.

It wasn’t until my son took his girlfriend’s newly rescued kitten to McGrath Veterinary Center that we discovered this amazing clinic. McGrath is open early and late every day of the week, which made it incredibly convenient. After their positive experience with the kitten, my son suggested we switch our dog’s care to McGrath as well—and I’m so glad we did.

We’ve been here several times now, and every visit has been absolutely wonderful. Unlike the previous clinic, where everything felt rushed and chaotic (perhaps due to their direct relationship with the animal shelter making them busier), McGrath offers a much calmer, more personalized experience.

When it comes to costs, it’s hard to compare because no treatment is ever exactly the same. However, I’ve come to McGrath for more serious treatments and was pleasantly surprised by their reasonable fees. More importantly, their transparency is something I truly appreciate. At our previous clinic, I was often handed a bill with a list of procedures and a total at the end—no discussion. At McGrath, the process is completely different. They first explain the cost of a procedure and ask if I’m comfortable proceeding. Then, depending on the results, they outline the next steps along with estimated costs before moving forward. I never feel blindsided, only informed and involved in the decision-making process.  In the end, it cost me $296 for the visit, the ear swab, ear cleaning and ear medication.

I work at a dental practice where we pride ourselves on being open, honest, and ethical (which, unfortunately, is an industry that sometimes suffers from a bad reputation due to shady practices). We also ensure our pricing is fair and transparent, so finding a veterinary clinic that upholds the same values is refreshing.

The clinical staff I’ve encountered have been incredibly kind. Dr. Miller, Carolina, and another team member (whose name I unfortunately forgot) all showed the exact level of compassion and professionalism needed in such stressful situations.

Thank you, McGrath Veterinary Center, for the love and care you provide.
